question: Can regularized, train-fold-only distance conditioning make balanced-median OI competitive with a linear probe under nuisance geometry while preserving genuine-overlap reliability and nonlinear ranking utility?

candidates.name: oi_refined_global_isotropy
candidates.definition: OAS covariance on global-centered training rows; retain the shrunk diagonal and inverse-square-root scale it

candidates.name: oi_refined_pooled_diagonal
candidates.definition: OAS covariance on training residuals about training class means; retain the shrunk diagonal and inverse-square-root scale it

candidates.name: oi_refined_pooled_full
candidates.definition: OAS covariance on training residuals about training class means; symmetric full inverse-square-root transform

candidates.name: raw_conditioned_disagreement
candidates.definition: absolute score difference between B and E; it is not a selector and cannot be promoted

candidates.name: panel_selective_capped_probe_guardrail
candidates.trigger: run the capped probe for every model in a selection panel when any model has B refinement applied-rate >= 0.50 or abs(B-E score) >= 0.05; otherwise rank the full panel by the promoted OI candidate

conditioning.held_out_policy: apply the frozen fitted transform and call score_fixed without refitting

screen.promotion: A and B must be exact; among eligible C/D/E, minimize the upper paired 95% bound for nuisance-linear regret, then robustness AUC; candidates within 0.001 on both use fixed simplicity order C,D,E. No outcome-specific tuning is allowed.

statistics.bootstrap_estimator: v3_pooled_rows_seed_bootstrap for synthetic; paired replicate-block bootstrap for Food-101
statistics.rank_auc: trapezoidal AUC of rank association across frozen budgets
statistics.regret: best frozen reference accuracy minus reference accuracy of selector-chosen model

historical_genuine_overlap_gates.separated_fpr: if baseline FPR@0.05 >= 0.10, candidate-minus-baseline upper 95% bound < 0; otherwise upper bound <= 0.02
historical_genuine_overlap_gates.family_drift_material_improvement_requir: at least two of three families have upper paired bound < 0 and none has upper bound > 0.02
historical_genuine_overlap_gates.stable_shift: all degradation deltas require upper paired bound <= 0; crossing zero is inconclusive
historical_genuine_overlap_gates.strata_fnr: every k-by-balance stratum must have upper paired bound <= 0 for pass; upper <= 0.05 while crossing zero is inconclusive

provisional_product_gates.nonlinear_retention: for each quadratic, kNN, and RBF reference, candidate regret minus B regret upper paired 95% bound <= 0.01 accuracy
provisional_product_gates.baseline_parity: A and B exact bit-for-bit against direct current estimators
provisional_product_gates.determinism: exact repeated fitted state, diagnostics, and scores

runtime.larger_food_budget: candidate median total time must remain below full probe

early_stop: clear runtime or memory gate violation
excluded_rejected_ideas: post-hoc prototype or adjacency variants from the archived nuisance battery
